mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claim ( claim_id, case_id, interaction_id, claim_type, claim_status, statement_text, valid_from, valid_to, recorded_at, supersedes_claim_id, model_run_id ) VALUES ( #{claimId}, #{caseId}, null, #{claimType}, #{status}, #{statement}, #{validFrom, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{validTo, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{recordedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{supersedesClaimId}, null )
mapper.select: SELECT claim_id, case_id, claim_type, claim_status, statement_text, valid_from, valid_to, recorded_at, supersedes_claim_id FROM claim WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY recorded_at
mapper.update: UPDATE claim SET claim_status = #{status} WHERE claim_id = #{claimId}
